Many People Are Not Lazy

They Are Just Fighting Battles That Success Has Not Yet Explained

One thing we must stop doing is comparing people’s harvest without knowing their soil. Some people are growing from places of love, support, money, connection, and peace. Others are growing from survival, confusion, rejection, lack, and trauma. The fruits may not appear at the same time.
